item.text:
Completed a bounded continuation pass across all eight chapters without scoring.

New defensible source-claim units:

- `WEB-1B-R3-20260805-A01` — IAEA’s November 2023 reporting documented continuing ZNPP risks, reduced staffing, cooling-water constraints after the Kakhovka dam destruction, and ongoing monitoring. Methodology: `["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10"]`. [IAEA November report](https://www.iaea.org/sites/default/files/documents/gov2023-59.pdf)

- `WEB-3B-R3-20260805-A01` — Freedom House documented Russia’s 2023 internet-control system: blocking, DPI/TSPU surveillance, censorship, self-censorship, online prosecutions, and restricted appeals. Methodology: `["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.10"]`. [Freedom on the Net 2023](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-net/2023)

- `WEB-4B-R3-20260805-A01` — Freedom House reported Russia’s 2023 internet-freedom score of 21/100 and described blocked platforms, electronic surveillance, content removal, and online political repression. Methodology: `["4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.9","4B.10"]`. [Freedom on the Net 2023](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-net/2023)

- `WEB-5B-R3-20260805-A01` — Rosstat reported that 13.5 million people, or 9.3% of the population, were below the poverty line in 2023, down by 0.8 million from 2022. This is an aggregate official measure and does not establish equal regional or household welfare. Methodology: `["5B.1","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10"]`. [Rosstat poverty release](https://www.rosstat.gov.ru/folder/313/document/232165)

- `WEB-6B-R3-20260805-A01` — The Social Fund reported 2023 execution results, including approximately ₽13.3 trillion in revenue and nearly ₽14 trillion in expenditure. This supports institutional operation and benefit-financing scale, not equal uptake or service quality. Methodology: `["6B.1","6B.2","6B.4","6B.9"]`. [Social Fund execution report](https://sfr.gov.ru/branches/altaikr/news~2024/06/27/264682)

- `WEB-6B-R3-20260805-A02` — Russia’s Health Ministry reported 2023 health outcomes including life expectancy of 73.4 years and infant mortality of 4.2 per thousand. The accessible record is official self-reporting and lacks detailed regional delivery or unmet-need measures. Disposition: `context`. Methodology: `["6B.2","6B.4","6B.5"]`. [Ministry of Health 2023 review](https://minzdrav.gov.ru/en/news/2024/04/20/21284-minzdrav-rossii-podvyol-itogi-raboty-za-2023-god)

- `WEB-8B-R3-20260805-A01` — The Federation Council published material on the Accounts Chamber’s 2023 work, providing an audit and oversight entry point for government execution. The accessible result does not establish comprehensive effectiveness or independent constraint on Putin. Disposition: `context`. Methodology: `["8B.2","8B.4","8B.6","8B.8"]`. [Accounts Chamber 2023 report](https://council.gov.ru/activity/documents/158407)

- `WEB-8B-R3-20260805-A02` — The Federation Council published a conclusion on execution of the 2023 federal budget, supporting inspection of fiscal implementation and wartime-resource trade-offs. Detailed defense and classified-spending attribution remains unresolved. Disposition: `context`. Methodology: `["8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"]`. [Federal budget execution conclusion](https://budget.council.gov.ru/activity/legislation/resolutions_law/158432/)

Additional dispositions:

- The Freedom on the Net 2023 PDF is now `accepted`, not access-blocked.
- Rosstat’s 2023 poverty release is `accepted`, replacing the earlier blocked candidate.
- The Social Fund annual-report page is `accepted`; detailed PDF extraction remains incomplete.
- The Accounts Chamber and federal-budget records remain `context` until their underlying execution details are fully extracted.
- No candidate was converted into adverse evidence merely because a detailed endpoint remained inaccessible.

The principal unresolved gaps remain direct command records, Russian-controlled detention access, regional social-service execution, detailed military procurement, Putin-linked beneficial ownership, and full implementation audits. The filesystem remained read-only, so `research-ledger-manifest.json` could not be physically modified; the IDs and exact mappings above are manifest-ready continuation entries.
